## 📋 Description

A clear and concise description of what this pull request achieves and why it is needed.

---

## 🎯 Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: A new feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] `fix`: A bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] `refactor`: A code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] `perf`: A code change that improves performance
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation only changes
- [ ] `test`: Adding missing tests or correcting existing tests
- [ ] `ci`: Changes to CI/CD configuration files and scripts
- [ ] `chore`: Miscellaneous task that doesn't modify src or test files

---

## 🔬 How Has This Been Tested?

Describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes. Provide instructions so we can reproduce.

- [ ] Unit tests (`npm test` / Vitest)
- [ ] Integration tests (Database / Testcontainers)
- [ ] End-to-End tests (Playwright)
- [ ] Manual verification in local Docker Compose environment

---

## 🛡️ Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or lint errors
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published in downstream modules
- [ ] Architectural decisions have been documented in `docs/adr/` (if applicable)
